paramDocs.colors: Stripe colors, assigned cyclically. Defaults to light blue shades.
paramDocs.thickness: Thickness of each stripe in pixels. Defaults to `40`.
paramDocs.gap: Transparent gap in pixels between each stripe. Defaults to `0`.
paramDocs.angle: Rotates the pattern in degrees. Defaults to `0`.
paramDocs.offset: Offset in pixels. Animate to scroll through the bands. Defaults to `0`.
paramDocs.amplitude: Wave displacement in pixels. Defaults to `24`.
paramDocs.wavelength: Distance in pixels before the wave repeats. Defaults to `160`.
paramDocs.phase: Wave phase in degrees. Defaults to `0`.
paramDocs.maskToSourceAlpha: Masks the generated wave pattern to the source alpha channel. Defaults to `false`.

paramDocs.temperature: Blue-to-amber temperature adjustment from `-1` to `1`. Defaults to `0`.
paramDocs.tint: Green-to-magenta tint adjustment from `-1` to `1`. Defaults to `0`.

paramDocs.amount: Blend amount from `0` to `1`. Defaults to `1`.
paramDocs.seed: Seed for the random noise pattern. Defaults to `0`.

paramDocs.colors: Stripe colors, assigned cyclically. Same semantics as lines().
paramDocs.direction: Base band direction before zig-zag displacement. Same as lines().
paramDocs.thickness: Thickness of each colored band in pixels. Same as lines().
paramDocs.gap: Transparent gap in pixels between bands. Same as lines().
paramDocs.angle: Rotates the full pattern in degrees. Same as lines().
paramDocs.offset: Offset in pixels. Animate to scroll the bands. Same as lines().
paramDocs.wavelength: Distance in pixels before the zig-zag repeats.
paramDocs.maskToSourceAlpha: Masks the generated zig-zag pattern to the source alpha channel. Defaults to `false`.

paramDocs.amount: Blur strength in pixels. Defaults to `40`.
paramDocs.center: Origin of the zoom blur in UV coordinates. Defaults to `[0.5, 0.5]`.
paramDocs.samples: Number of source samples. Higher values are smoother. Defaults to `24`.
